english.meaning: to go up close to something or someone
english.note: Used as 走埋去, walk up close.

exampleSentences.english: Now that you mention it, I haven’t really noticed their hand. But I don’t often get to go over and look at it.
exampleSentences.traditional: 你噉講就我就唔係好留意佢隻手喇。但係都冇乜幾可走埋去睇佢隻手𠸏。
